meta.message: Here's a 12-frame, one-shot first-aid heal on a 64x128 canvas, side view with no ground ring: white bandage strips coil up the torso, a soft green-white plus glows over the chest and fades, and green sparkles drift upward. No sprite came with your message, so I couldn't draw the man; the effect is centred on a standing figure's torso, and it will line up when you place your sprite. Try the sparkle count and the plus glow strength in the sliders, and I can thicken the bandage strips if they read too thin at 1x.
